input.content: P1 pattern: consumer increment hard-requires a new response field (e.g. receipt `applied: True`) that the released provider does not return, in a repo where client and provider ship independently. Every call fails against the supported provider baseline even with the feature flag off. The provider has already applied the write, so the caller sees failure for a save that succeeded. The unit-test stub was edited to return the new field, which hid the incompatibility. Check: diff the consumer's required response shape against the released provider tag. Tolerate an absent new field until the provider ships, and keep a test using the legacy response shape.
